title: Ghassan and the Returning Voice
logline: Ghassan calls into the world and learns that every voice comes home.
story: At the rim of the great valley where Hayat, who was abundant life, was said to dwell, Ghassan — carrying the vigor of youth — shouted a harsh word into the dark, and a harsh word came back; then Ghassan shouted a kind one, and kindness returned. For a long while Ghassan only listened to the echoes, learning their quiet law. By dusk Ghassan understood that the valley had never invented a single sound — it had only returned what was given. Ghassan walked home speaking gently, knowing the world was an honest mirror.
moral: Whatever you send into the world returns to you; the world keeps no other ledger.
